name: Holiday Traditional Spiced Pumpkin Pie Slice with Whipped Cream
whyItWorks: Smooth pureed pumpkin custard baked in a tender flour crust. Pumpkin provides soluble fiber and beta-carotene that is gentle on mucosal linings. Completely seed-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a slice of pumpkin pie warm or chilled with a dollop of whipped cream.
watchOuts: Contains dairy evaporated milk and egg custard
